view.scene_description: A modern, spacious interior with large windows, contemporary furniture, and vibrant lighting. A spiral bookshelf stands near the window, while a large digital screen displays an image. Warm-toned chairs cluster around tables, and illuminated shelves line a staircase. The ceiling features recessed lights and a decorative fixture.

objects.label: spiral bookshelf
objects.observation: A cylindrical, multi-tiered bookshelf with glowing edges, positioned near the left window. Books are arranged on its levels. It stands on a polished floor, partially illuminated by natural light from the window behind it.

objects.label: large digital screen
objects.observation: A wide, rectangular screen mounted on a wall, displaying a close-up of a person's face. It is situated centrally in the background, above a wooden shelf unit. The screen emits bright light, contrasting with the surrounding purple-lit walls.

objects.label: orange chairs
objects.observation: Multiple curved, orange upholstered chairs arranged in clusters around tables. They have metal bases and are positioned throughout the room, some facing the screen, others toward windows or other seating areas.

objects.label: tables
objects.observation: Round or oval tables with dark surfaces, placed between chairs. Some tables hold items like cups or papers. They rest on the polished floor, supporting the chairs and occasionally people sitting at them.

objects.label: illuminated shelves
objects.observation: Wooden shelving units with warm backlighting, located to the right of the digital screen and along a staircase. Books and decorative items are displayed on them, casting a soft glow against the purple wall behind.

objects.label: staircase
objects.observation: A modern staircase with yellow-lit steps, ascending to the right side of the frame. It is framed by illuminated shelves and leads to an upper level, partially obscured by the angle of the shot.

objects.label: ceiling fixture
objects.observation: A large, circular, textured ceiling light fixture with embedded bulbs, hanging from the ceiling on the left. It emits a soft glow and has a metallic finish, contrasting with the darker ceiling.

objects.label: people
objects.observation: Two individuals seated at a table near the digital screen, appearing to converse or work. Their faces are partially visible, and they are seated in chairs, suggesting a casual or collaborative environment.

prompts.native_chat_prompt_text:
<|im_start|>system
You are a helpful assistant<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>user
<|vision_start|><|image_pad|><|vision_end|>Inspect the photograph. Return ONLY one JSON object, no markdown or text outside JSON. Describe the complete scene and list visible objects with separate local integer IDs, separating instances when possible. For every object describe visible appearance, image-relative location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relationships. State uncertainty; do not infer hidden fasteners, weight or permanent installation. Do not classify stability or mobility. Use English text.
Required JSON structure (the angle-bracket text specifies field meaning, not example objects):
{"scene_description":"<full scene description>","objects":[{"id":1,"label":"<visible object name>","observation":"<visible appearance, location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relations>","attachment_evidence":"not_visible","identifiable":true}]}
List all discernible objects, not just one. Every object needs these five fields. attachment_evidence must be visible_installation, appears_freestanding, not_visible or mixed; visible_installation requires visible mounting or integration. Use not_visible when attachment cannot be established. scene_description about 120 words or fewer; each observation about 60 words or fewer.

Describe the photograph using these inputs:
{"frame_id": "thud_agtea_test50/image-000039", "image_size": [960, 540], "annotation_kind": "unspecified", "supplied_objects": null}<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>assistant
